name: Tonearm
author: Sean Sandys
description: Roon now-playing, transport, library search and zone transfer in the bar. Needs a one-time setup step that installs tonearmd, a Python systemd user service which talks to your Roon Core and starts at login. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle ssandys.tonearm

barWidget.description: Roon now-playing, transport, library search, zone switching and transfer

schema.label: Tint the seek bar with the album's color
